summary: Preinstall obfuscated dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes opaque bundled payload
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0x...` identifiers, string/function proxy objects, array-rotation decoder patterns) that checks for `bun` on PATH and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the package-local `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily-obfuscated bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, large numeric/string constant array with a `WV8StW` array-rotation decoder and rotating single-letter globals) whose content is not human-readable and does not correspond to the package's advertised purpose (React/mobx UI examples). The alternate-runtime path bypasses Node-based install-time inspection: the executed code never enters the Node dependency graph and is run by a freshly-fetched second-language interpreter. The install-time script itself is obfuscated, indicating deliberate concealment of the actions performed. Installing this version triggers the fetch-and-execute chain automatically on `npm install` without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
